newsitem.title: UK: Amersham sells Myoview Injectable in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Amersham sells Myoview Injectable in Japan.

text.p: British-based health science group Amersham International Plc said on Monday its Japanese joint venture had launched Amersham's heart-imaging agent Myoview Injectable on the Japanese market.

Amersham, which set up Nihon Medi-Physics Co Ltd with Sumitomo Chemical Co Ltd in a drive to capture what it regards as the key Japanese market, said it received approval to sell the ready-to-inject version of Myoview in October 1996.

Amersham said Myoview Injectable is an injectable conjugate form of Myoview, which was first launched in the Japanese market in kit form in 1994. It said the Japanese market preferred ready-to-inject formulations.
